# Esc on a header button inside a playlist (fix/lib113), with the demo's made-up library. Compare each shot with the same
# script on main.
# - lib113-on-grid-button: the playlist "Late-night building" is open and the white focus ring is round the Grid button
#   at the top right (Up from the playlist's songs goes there). The same on both.
# - lib113-esc-from-grid-button: after Esc. On the branch the playlist is closed, the Playlists grid shows with the first
#   playlist card picked (purple outline) and there is NO white ring round the Grid button. On main the same grid and
#   card show, but the white ring is still round the Grid button (the keyboard stayed there, and the Narrator said nothing).
# - lib113-esc-then-right: Right after that. On the branch the picked card moves on to "Elytra runs" (the second playlist)
#   and no ring is on the header. On main the ring moves along the header (from Grid to Shelf) and the first card stays picked.
# The other fixes on the branch only change what the Narrator says, which no shot can show (unit tests cover them).
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/lib113 -f script=.github/checks/lib113.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 6
set libraryView GRID
guiscale 3
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
# Liked songs -> Playlists, the first playlist, open it, then Up onto the Grid button
key tab
sleep 1
key right
sleep 0.5
key enter
sleep 2
key up
sleep 1
shot lib113-on-grid-button
key escape
sleep 2
shot lib113-esc-from-grid-button
key right
sleep 1
shot lib113-esc-then-right
close
guiscale 0
